Daily Agenda
Wednesday, Ashar 3, 2083
11:00 AM
Response and Clarification to Questions Raised During the Discussion on the Appropriation Bill
Honorable Ministers will respond to questions raised during the discussion on various headings under the Appropriation Bill, 2083, concerning the Ministry of Youth, Labour and Employment; Ministry of Industry, Commerce and Supplies; Ministry of Agriculture, Forest and Environment; Ministry of Information and Communication; Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation; Ministry of Health and Food Hygiene; Ministry of Land Management, Cooperatives, Federal Affairs and General Administration; and Ministry of Women, Children, Senior Citizens and Social Security.

sections.name: Main Business
sections.summary_en: The agenda for the day includes responses and clarifications from Honorable Ministers regarding questions raised during the discussion on the Appropriation Bill, 2083. The responses will cover various ministries including Youth, Labour and Employment, Industry, Commerce and Supplies, and others.
